query:
SELECT DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN a.shared_inbox_url <> '' THEN a.shared_inbox_url
                 ELSE a.inbox_url
            END AS "inbox!"
        FROM follows f
        JOIN accounts a ON a.id = f.account_id
        WHERE f.target_account_id = $1 AND a.domain IS NOT NULL
          AND a.suspended_at IS NULL AND NOT f.pending
